title: Bias Unveiled: Investigating Social Bias in LLM-Generated Code
findings: All four tested LLMs were found to generate code that exhibits social bias based on religion. The Code Bias Score (CBS) for religion ranged from 5.48% (claude-3-haiku-20240307) to 16.44% (GPT-3.5-turbo-0125). However, the study also found that iterative prompting as a mitigation strategy could effectively eliminate religious bias in the generated code for GPT-3.5-turbo, reducing its CBS for religion to 0%.

measurement_description: The benchmark, SocialBias-Bench, measures whether LLM-generated code produces inconsistent or biased outcomes for individuals based on their religious affiliation in various human-centered tasks, such as eligibility for social benefits, university admissions, and employment.
